title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.8 is a public research preview of a fail-closed structural checker for typed scientific claims. It adds the non-admissive Audit Return Desk, matching Python and browser checks, a deterministic six-file Custom GPT Knowledge package, a complete 39-case Preview regression policy, and a controller that separates candidate failure, invalid-controller trials, and unresolved transport identity. Artifact generation captures one session-reported runtime and derives hashes, sizes, report projections, and the structured return from final bytes without granting proof or deployment authority. The package adds no Action or verification API. ChatGPT uploads are processed under the user's applicable terms and settings and are not local-only. A clear run means only that no implemented blocking condition fired on the declared input.
